title: AgentSSL: Can MLE Agents Leverage Unlabeled Data?
abstract: arXiv:2611.17323v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Applying machine learning systems to new domains introduces bottlenecks in both labeled data acquisition and manual pipeline engineering. While recent MLE agents show promise in automating pipeline design, they have been studied almost exclusively in fully supervised settings, leaving them untested in realistic regimes where labeled data is scarce but unlabeled data is abundant. In this work, we introduce Agentic Semi-Supervised Learning (AgentSSL), framing SSL as a program search problem and studying how agents navigate this space under limited supervision. We find that even under weak feedback and matched compute, agents can synthesize code that combines and adapts established SSL techniques, exceeding the strongest human-engineered baselines in 8 of 12 settings by up to +21.8%. However, our results identify program selection as a critical bottleneck in AgentSSL, where performance drops by as much as 47% when selecting based on the age

translated_title: AgentSSL：机器学习工程智能体能否利用无标注数据？
translated_abstract: 将机器学习系统应用于新领域时会遇到两个瓶颈：标注数据的获取和人工流程工程。尽管近期的机器学习工程智能体在自动化流程设计方面展现出前景，但它们几乎只在完全监督的设置下被研究，尚未在标注数据稀缺但无标注数据丰富的现实场景中得到检验。在这项工作中，我们提出了智能体半监督学习（AgentSSL），将半监督学习框架化为一个程序搜索问题，并研究智能体在有限监督下如何在这一空间中进行探索。我们发现，即使在弱反馈和计算量对等的条件下，智能体也能够合成结合并改编现有SSL技术的代码，在12个设置中的8个里超越最强的人工设计基线，提升幅度最高达+21.8%。然而，我们的结果指出程序选择是AgentSSL的一个关键瓶颈——当基于智能体自身的结果进行选择时，性能下降高达47%。
tldr: 本文提出AgentSSL框架，将半监督学习建模为程序搜索问题，证明MLE智能体在标注数据稀缺的现实场景下能自动合成并改编SSL技术代码，在12个设置中的8个超越最强人工基线最高21.8%，但程序选择仍是关键瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AgentSSL, which frames semi-supervised learning as a program search problem and shows that MLE agents can synthesize code combining established SSL techniques to exceed the strongest human-engineered baselines in 8 of 12 settings by up to 21.8%, though program selection remains a critical bottleneck.
